deeper-life.title: Obulamu Obw'obuziba
deeper-life.description: Obutukuvu, okwewaayo, n'obulamu obw'ekyengera obukwekeddwa mu Kristo — ebitabo eby'okugenda mu maaso ennyo mu by'omwoyo.

scripture.text: Kubanga mwafa, n'obulamu bwammwe bukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda.

enduring-classics.title: Ebitabo eby'Edda Ebisigalawo
enduring-classics.description: Ebitabo ebitambulidde n'abatambuze okumala ebyasa — okwatula kwa Awugusitino, ekirooto kya Bunyan, amagezi ga Kempis — amakubo ag'edda, era nga makyali malungi.

faith-and-guidance.title: Okukkiriza n'Obulagirizi
faith-and-guidance.description: Okwesiga Katonda olw'emmere eya buli lunaku, obulagirizi, na buli kisuubizo — okutambula mu kukkiriza, so si mu kulaba.

scripture.text: Mu makubo go gonna mumumanye, naye alitereeza amakubo go.

grace-and-comfort.title: Ekisa n'Okubudaabuda
grace-and-comfort.description: Ekisa kya Katonda ekitaggwaawo n'okubudaabuda kwe mu kugezesebwa kwonna — amawulire amalungi eri abakooye.

scripture.text: Ekisa kyange kikumala: kubanga amaanyi gange gatuukirizibwa mu bunafu.

holy-spirit.title: Omwoyo Omutukuvu
holy-spirit.description: Okubatizibwa kw'Omwoyo, okutuula kwe mu ffe, n'omulimu gwe — amaanyi agaasuubizibwa ag'obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo.

scripture.text: Si na maanyi, so si na buyinza, wabula na Mwoyo gwange, bw'ayogera Mukama ow'eggye.

prayer.title: Ku Kusaba
prayer.description: Okuyiga okusaba — era n'okunyiikira okusaba obutakoowa. Ebitabo eby'edda ebyogera ku bulamu obw'omunda obw'okusaba, okuva mu kifo eky'ekyama okutuuka ku kwegayiririra abalala okw'amaanyi.

scripture.text: Munkoowoole, nange ndikuyitaba, ne nkulaga ebintu ebikulu era eby'ekitalo, by'otomanyi.

revival-and-missions.title: Okuzuukusibwa n'Obuweereza bw'Enjiri
revival-and-missions.description: Obulamu obwawaayo olw'enjiri, n'ebiseera eby'okuzuukusibwa — eky'okwongera omuliro mu mutima ogwaka.

scripture.text: Ai Mukama, zzaamu obulamu omulimu gwo wakati mu myaka, wakati mu myaka gumanyise.

the-gospel-call.title: Okuyita kw'Enjiri
the-gospel-call.description: Okuyitibwa okusinga obukadde — jjangu, weenenye, kkiriza. Ababuulizi nga beegayirira abatannaba kulokoka, n'obujulirwa bw'ekisa ekyalabwa omwonoonyi asinga bonna.

the-preached-word.title: Ekigambo Ekibuulirwa
the-preached-word.description: Okubuulira okw'amaanyi ku lupapula — Whitefield ne Wesley mu ddoboozi eryonna, Spurgeon mu balimi be — n'ekiragiro kya Baxter eri buli musumba w'emyoyo.

the-way-of-holiness.title: Ekkubo ery'Obutukuvu
the-way-of-holiness.description: Okwawulibwa ku lwa Katonda — amateeka nga gakebejjebwa, obutuukirivu nga bunoonyezebwa n'obwesimbu, n'okwagala kw'omutima nga kugezesebwa ne kulabika nga kwa mazima.
